unsupported.title: This device is not supported
unsupported.body: Please open notefall on a desktop or tablet in landscape orientation — a wider screen is required.

webgl.title: Hardware acceleration is required
webgl.body: notefall renders the falling notes with WebGL, which needs your browser's hardware acceleration to be on.
